notes: All records identify 韓王信, Xin, King of Han: the descendant of the Han royal house who was transferred to Dai, defected to the Xiongnu, and was killed at Canhe in BC 196. Shiji 93 is his full biography and supplies the same ancestry, career, and sons.

韓信, Marquis of Huaiyin, and 韓王信, Xin, King of Han, are distinct contemporaries. The Han Xin named in Jin History 35 is the ancient Marquis of Huaiyin in the Martial Temple roster, not a Jin-era homonym.
